ledger: E6 · A thread the human opens is an amendment, folded like an answer
ledger_text: "`spec.md` on the remote carries the amendment; a `✅ [<role>] amended` reply; the thread resolved." (a human-opened thread has one comment and no `[role]` tag, so the answered-thread rule skipped it while patrol classified it actionable — every pass reported "no new answers" — issue #62)
